title: 2 Person Folding Camping Cot For Adults, 50Extra Wide Outdoor Portable Sleeping Cot With Carry Bag, Elevated Camping Bed, Beach Hiking, Blue
body_html:

  • - Includes travel bag

  • - Folded Dimensions: 38.2" L x 5.9" W x 7.5" H
